In any case, I have loaded up a bunch of images I think would work well to alternate back and forth. That way, we keep any sense of continuity, even if there would be no more “visual” page to care about. So I guess what I’m saying is, color me worried about not choosing a page color.

Noor is already at Koh Samui so she has wound her clocks however she wishes to (I imagine early). We’ll do some planning tonight which is probably the wisest approach for this. Hey? What do you mean **midnight Saturday**? You mean former job, saving up to sustain my life again? Damn.

Part of me feels like I’ve glossed over something important to last night, as the main Lords Day adventure doesn’t quite match today, and there’s not much of a feast yet. However, I have felt pretty great all day and this could be partially the influence of resolute yesterday (all of those written verses were burning up a bunch of my good spirit yesterday I think). I have actually had time and energy to do things outside of wiki’ing (shocking right?) and It was mostly good times in short supply. For maybe a 40% chance, I hope Sunday is a fun beach day.

Ugh if I could sleep now I could be rested and energized for the last around! But the wiki-zeit has carried on towards the breaking night. I guess this is what you get for writing about a sleepless problem.

Okay make another brief plan.

Writing prompt: Home.

Monday's prompts started innocently enough: Either the job Antoine applied for has been granted or you've remembered that perfect piece of furniture. (either or!) But the idea of either remembering something perfect, or having something good happen quickly grew into the idea that maybe a good thing had been remembered rather than experienced. Finally, I turned the meaning of 'at home' in 'at home with' on its head, and that was the idea I ended up playing with this week.

I also wanted to do something that was more visual than usual, involving more than my blobs of letters. And maybe something that showed more of my toothpaste blog-related tastes.

Hope you like the photos!

It's not a home without a slinky, is it? Or did I just get a bit too homesick for my place in Singapore?
Yes, Australia has adorable native wildlife, cool weather(!), MTV and ice, and yet I still find myself feeling homesick.
The more I think about it, the more I realised that open-faced sandwiches are one of the few things I really miss about Singapore. Man, I've been craving them too, but they seem too western for Singapore; and way too complicated for me to prepare here.
For the first few months, I guessed that it was the familiar surroundings and tasty food that I missed the most. But now, it's things like 2-hour nieces, super size shopping centres and comfortable trains. I think being able to be even more slobby would make me happy! Plus, TPing. I never remembered how much I missed stealing the covers just before I go to sleep until I had to circulate to make sure it wasn't buried under a huge pile of coats and other refuse...
When it came to writing the prompt, I tried writing from Antoine's POV. Nothing too bad came of that (although I now know that bumping into an online dating advert in a cafe in need of a date is still not a great idea. If I were a literary spinster, I'd definitely start one there...)
